bluePosts.author: Blizzard employees
bluePosts.title: World of Warcraft: Forever launches globally on November 4th!
paras: Embark on your first adventure in World of Warcraft: Forever, or return to a refreshed Azeroth. The game will launch globally on November 4th at 3: 00pm PST. Adventure to level 60 on the Classic Continent, explore new stories, and meet like-minded adventurers. It will coexist with official suits and Classic Era, making it your permanent home, community first, and journey.
As important as the destination.

bluePosts.author: community Manager
bluePosts.title: Overrestrictive Name Check and Fix-October 27
paras: In World of Warcraft: Forever, we've been working on the restricted name list, which is the list the game uses to check for non-professional names we want to restrict, such as major Warcraft knowledge characters or names blocked for technical reasons.
Today, we have determined that there was an error in our process that caused the game to be too strict.
For example, it incorrectly restricts names that contain "c-o-n."

As the next domain for each region restarts, we will implement the fix. After that, if you previously received a message saying that the name you thought should be allowed "This name is restricted", please feel free to try again.
Thank you, sir.

bluePosts.author: community Manager
bluePosts.title: Oceania player build character server type problem
paras: Oceania players playing on Australia servers please note:
There is a bug: if you want to create roles on a role-playing or role-playing PvP type server, you must create these roles first and then create roles on a normal or PvP type server.
Once you build a role on a regular or PvP server first, and then build a role later, you can't select a role playing or role playing PvP server.
This issue only affects Oceania players connected to Australia servers. Blizzard is working on an emergency fix.

paras: Hello, everyone.

In a recent World of Warcraft: Forever podcast, we talked about some of the concerns about adding the RPG PvP rules to World of Warcraft: Forever, but also mentioned that we are still discussing this internally and are monitoring player feedback. Over the past few days, we have carefully evaluated the work required to add it to World of Warcraft: Forever and
Decided to implement. We will be adding the role play PvP rules when we open the service on November 4th.

bluePosts.title: Advance Notice: October 21st World of Warcraft: Forever Stress Test
paras: The World of Warcraft: Foreverthe beta realm will be officially closed on October 21, 2012, and stress testing will be opened on official hardware in all regions. Taipei time (same as Beijing time) will be from 5:00 to 9:00 on October 22, 2012, and Pacific time will be from 14:00 to 18:00 on October 21, 2012.
Any player with a World of Warcraft account can participate, no subscription required.

How to participate: Update the graphics driver; open the Battle Network client and complete the update; select World of Warcraft from the game list, select "World of Warcraft: Forever Stress Test" from the game version menu above the "Start Game" button from "Developing" and install it; enter the game after the test begins, select a beta realm server, and create a new character to participate in the test.

After the stress testing, all stress-tested characters (including their names) will be removed and the beta realm will be reopened. Officials plan to permanently close World of Warcraft: Foreverthe beta realm on Friday, October 23 at 10:00 Pacific Time (1:00 Beijing Time, October 24).

bluePosts.author: community Manager
bluePosts.title: Combating the gold coin trade: temporary economic restraint mechanisms
paras: The official launch of a new mechanism to combat real currency transactions. Accounts suspected of selling or receiving illegal coins may be temporarily restricted from trading, mail, guild banks and auction houses to prevent suspicious coins from continuing to circulate and allow time for investigation. Normal accounts will not be affected; restrictions will be automatically lifted after investigation. If violations are confirmed, they will be punished by accounts. Misjudgments may occur during the adjustment of the new system. Temporary restrictions will not leave a permanent penalty record. If validated, the mechanism will be used in other versions of World of Warcraft as well.

The customer service team will not directly participate in the beta realm problem handling; players without a valid North American Warcraft license cannot post in the North American beta forum, or you can go to the European beta forum to report feedback.

bluePosts.title: Developer Supplement: Dungeon Experience
paras: The developers added something that wasn't mentioned in the podcast: The previous experience points for teams to kill were based on the highest level player in the team, and the lower level players got very little. Now it's fixed to be based on their own level, plus the dungeon kill experience increased by 20%. Officials say the adjusted dungeon leveling speed is about the same as efficient quests, and won't return to the obvious faster dungeon grinding as in the Classic Era.

bluePosts.author: community Manager, Official reply
bluePosts.title: October 1 Development Notes

All nine classes have been modified, with Warrior changing the most.(Critical Strike Rage, Fury, and Defense talent reshuffled); Druids removed Tiger Rage and added two Cat Form talents. Dungeon quest bonus EXP reduced by 50%, Honor item price increased by approximately 50%, Honor cap increased to 25000.

paras: Officials are gathering information to confirm the cause of the problem and whether the fix is correct.

bluePosts.author: community Manager, Official reply
bluePosts.title: Character name already exists: plan to restart the beta realm
paras: The community manager said in the discussion of the role name anomaly that the team was considering restarting the beta realm server that day.

bluePosts.author: community Manager, Official reply
bluePosts.title: "Role name already exists" problem
paras: Some players can no longer enter the character after disconnection, prompt character name already exists. Please attach the character name and the exact time of the last normal game and disconnection when reporting, so as to facilitate checking logs.

bluePosts.author: community Manager, Official reply
bluePosts.title: Skyborne Mission Stuck Fixed
paras: An event on a Skyborne quest on Windy Island will get stuck halfway through, causing it to be unable to continue; the fix from the previous few days did not take effect, but this time it has been fixed and the player can complete the quest.

bluePosts.author: Blizzard employees
bluePosts.title: double naming convention
paras: Each character can take two names, complete double names are unique in the same region, so the first part of the name can be repeated with others.

bluePosts.author: Blizzard employees
bluePosts.title: Choose rules over servers
paras: Instead of picking from a list of servers, players choose a rule: normal, PvP, role-playing, or hardcore, each of which is a large overall community; hardcore is only available after launch.

bluePosts.author: community Manager, Official reply
bluePosts.title: Can not start the game processing method
paras: The official explanation is that the test forum is open to all subscribers; and share personal experience: when the game cannot be updated, you can delete the data folder in the game directory and let Battle. net repair again.

bluePosts.author: community Manager, Official reply
bluePosts.title: Graphics Requirements
paras: Remind players: After the official launch, some of the old graphics card architecture far below the minimum configuration will no longer be supported. See the official graphics card requirements for details.

bluePosts.author: community Manager, Official reply
bluePosts.title: Login issues with multiple game authorizations
paras: You can't select an account when there are multiple authorizations under the same Battle. net account. It is recommended to create a test account on the account management page to see if you can select it when logging in.

bluePosts.author: community Manager, Official reply
bluePosts.title: known problem supplement
paras: Added known issues: Cooldown manager not yet complete; armor bonuses for consumables and buffs are amplified by bear form; spell queue window is closed when queuing for next attack ability; missiles with full damage are fired when channeling arcane missiles; duration of low level resurrection weakness is incorrect.

bluePosts.author: community Manager
bluePosts.title: Known issues at the time of test initiation
paras: Known issues at launch: Barber Chair error, the beta realm friends feature turned off, minimaps may be out of screen, some supply box items could not be submitted, and several quest issues, most of which will be fixed in the next build.

bluePosts.author: Blizzard employees
bluePosts.title: Testing officially begins.
paras: The test runs from September 17 to October 21; you can sign up or purchase a designated gift package to qualify. The official launch time is November 4 (3 p.m. Pacific Time).

bluePosts.author: community Manager
bluePosts.title: Test Forum Open
paras: A dedicated test discussion area has been opened.

bluePosts.author: community Manager, Official reply
bluePosts.title: The beta realm gradually opens
paras: The beta realm is gradually letting people in.

bluePosts.author: community Manager
bluePosts.title: the beta realm is about to open
paras: A large number of players are waiting to enter the test, and officials are dealing with the last few questions, which will soon be open.

bluePosts.author: community Manager
bluePosts.title: Nine new dungeon levels
paras: Correction: Crodock Fortress is suitable for levels 40-45. The nine new dungeons are: Lord's Hall 13-18, Lordaeron Ruins 15-20, Digging Ground: Wetlands 24-29, Dalaran City 28-33, Sunken City 35-40, Crodock Fortress 40-45, Okaz Prison 48-53, Blackthroat Fortress 55-60, and Elementalist Platform 58-60.

bluePosts.author: community Manager
bluePosts.title: Eternal Edition announced at Blizzard Carnival
paras: The official summary post collects the published contents of the eternal edition.

bluePosts.author: community Manager
bluePosts.title: General Discussion Area Open
paras: Eternal version of the comprehensive discussion area open, please read the forum code of conduct before posting.

builds.summary: Blizzard announced the final round of changes to the racial specialties before the launch of the service in the development notes on October 26: more emphasis on the characteristics of each race, some races will be more suitable for certain positioning; previously changed to general bonuses to the specialties have been changed back, weapon specialization is still not restored; the rest of the passive bonus has also been adjusted. October 27 added to the original post Orc Blood Berserk, Undead Grief Touch and Troll Berserk three changes. Among them, the new cooldown time of Bloody Berserk has entered the client on October 28 (1.60.1.70658), listed below in this version; the rest of the changes have not been made in the client, and will take effect from the server when the service is opened. After the service is opened, the game data will prevail. Blizzard's post

entries.name: Ruthlessness
entries.desc: All spell and attack critical strike bonus reduced to 1% from 2%.

entries.name: The Earthfury
entries.desc: Removed. No longer increases critical strike damage and healing by 2%.

entries.name: Craftsman's precision
entries.desc: New racial feat: Increases hit chance for spells and attacks by 1%.

entries.name: Plainsrunning
entries.desc: Movement speed bonus per tier increased from 1% to 2%, max increased from 30% to 60%; no longer increases riding speed.

entries.name: Endurance
entries.desc: Retains only a 5% increase in total health. No longer increases critical damage and healing.

entries.name: atrocity
entries.desc: Removed. No longer increases critical strike chance by 1%.

entries.name: Command
entries.desc: Classic Era's Orc feat has been reintroduced: 5% more damage done by Warlock and Hunter pets.

entries.name: Berserk
entries.desc: Duration extended from 10 seconds to 15 seconds (added October 27).

entries.name: Touch of the Grave
entries.desc: Built-in cooldown reduced from 25 seconds to 15 seconds (Added October 27).

groups.name: Skyborne (High Order)
groups.line: Covers Wind Blessed, Read Ley Line.

entries.name: Read Ley Line
entries.desc: Life and mana regeneration bonus reduced from 100% to 50%. Lasts 15 seconds. Cannot be used during activation. Activates to replace it. When used next to the Weave, additional "Harmony" lasts 1 hour: Read Weave bonus returns to 100% during Harmony. Does not disappear after death. Disappears when entering party dungeons.

entries.name: Skysight
entries.desc: Movement speed bonus increased from 10% to 15% for 15 seconds. When used at Elemental Junction, additional "Charge" for 1 hour: Sky Vision bonus increased to 30% during charge. Does not disappear after death. Disappears when entering party dungeons.
